stories.title: Truth Magnum gets engaged aboard Chris Jericho Cruise
stories.tldr: AEW and ROH star Truth Magnum got engaged to his girlfriend Katie Jo during the seventh edition of Chris Jericho's Rock 'N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise. The in-ring proposal brought out a cheering crowd along with fellow wrestlers like Turbo Floyd, Dalton Castle, and Willow Nightingale. Magnum, known as one half of The Outrunners and a former ROH World Six Man Tag Team Champion, happily added the title of fiancé to his repertoire.

stories.title: HBO Max and Paramount+ merger plans and potential impact on AEW streaming
stories.tldr: Skydance has announced plans to bundle and eventually merge HBO Max and Paramount plus following its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. This massive streaming overhaul raises questions about the long term future of All Elite Wrestling, whose weekly shows, archives, and pay-per-views currently air on HBO Max and TNT or TBS through 2027. While AEW President Tony Khan has expressed confidence in his relationship with Skydance leadership, potential scheduling shifts and long-term rights renewals remain to be seen. Meanwhile, the newly combined media giant plans to spend roughly thirty billion dollars annually on content while integrating its sports and streaming operations.

stories.title: Mercedes Martinez provides recovery update after ACL surgery
stories.tldr: Veteran professional wrestler Mercedes Martinez has provided a rehabilitation update three weeks after undergoing surgery for a torn ACL, a small MCL tear, and discovered arthritis in her knee. The injury occurred in August during a match against Allie Catch, abruptly ending her planned retirement tour and in-ring career. To help alleviate the significant financial burden caused by a lack of insurance, a GoFundMe campaign has successfully raised over $12,000 for her medical bills.

stories.title: Mike Bailey reflects on his AEW singles title chase
stories.tldr: Mike Bailey recently reflected on his tenure with AEW in his latest YouTube vlog as he prepares for an upcoming match against Tommaso Ciampa for the National Championship. Having been with the promotion for over a year without capturing a singles title, Bailey boldly stated that it is about time he wins one. He also discussed his history of challenging for nearly every designated men's singles title in the company, though he noted he has yet to compete for the World Championship in a traditional one-on-one match.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher says match with Ilja Dragunov is inevitable
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently expressed on a TMZ podcast that a future singles match between himself and Ilja Dragunov is inevitable. Fletcher praised Dragunov following his recent AEW debut and noted they previously wrestled each other on the UK independent scene around 2019 and 2020. The two stars have followed very different career paths since then, but Fletcher believes Dragunov is a perfect fit for the roster and that they will create magic together in the ring. Meanwhile, Fletcher is currently preparing to challenge Will Ospreay for the AEW World Championship in the main event of Full Gear.

stories.title: Queen Aminata reacts to winning AEW TBS Championship
stories.tldr: Queen Aminata recently captured the AEW TBS Championship by defeating Persephone on AEW Fright Night Dynamite in what has been called the feel good moment of the year for the promotion. Celebrating her milestone achievement, Aminata revived her YouTube vlog to share her real-time emotional reactions to the victory. During the video, she admitted she was caught off guard by winning the title so soon and reflected on her five-year journey of hard work before dedicating the emotional win to her late father.

stories.title: Booker T advises Steven Borden to limit high-risk moves
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently advised Steven Borden, the son of wrestling legend Sting, to alter his in-ring style and eliminate high-risk dives. The recommendation follows Borden's scary landing at AEW All Out during a match alongside Darby Allin against Kevin Knight and Kyle Fletcher, which resulted in a doctor's stoppage. Although Borden has since made his return to AEW television on the October 21 edition of Dynamite, Booker T believes larger wrestlers should focus on traditional storytelling rather than trying to emulate smaller high-flyers. Furthermore, the veteran expressed a desire to have trained Borden himself to teach him safer working methods and the core elements of professional wrestling.

stories.title: Dutch Mantell gives thoughts on Lance Archer and reminisces about TNA run
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Dutch Mantell recently shared his belief that Lance Archer is a highly talented performer who deserves a major opportunity to prove himself. The conversation was sparked by Jake Roberts previously questioning why Archer has not received a world title push in All Elite Wrestling. Mantell agreed that Archer needs a chance to carry the ball and see what he can accomplish with a sustained push. He also looked back on Archer's historical run in TNA as Lance Hoyt, explaining how creative disorganization hindered the big man back then.

stories.title: Disco Inferno criticizes Mercedes Moné's believability
stories.tldr: Disco Inferno recently shared his criticisms of Mercedes Mone on a recent podcast appearance, arguing that she lacks the convincing physical presence of wrestling legends like Madusa. The discussion stemmed from a listener question about Dave Meltzers assessments of Mone and her recent matches. Disco used the opportunity to critique the current generation of wrestlers, claiming they prioritize complex move sequences and spots over foundational psychology, emotional realism, and proper selling.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa to defend AEW National Title on Dynamite/Collision show
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa recently captured the AEW National Championship, and his first defense has already been scheduled. He will put the gold on the line against Speedball Mike Bailey on this Wednesday's special combined edition of Dynamite and Collision. This marks the first-ever singles match between the two competitors. Bailey enters the bout looking for his first AEW singles title after coming up short in five previous opportunities this year.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli provides update on injury recovery
stories.tldr: Following his recent appearance at the League of Legends World Championship, Claudio Castagnoli provided a direct update on his status by confirming he has not yet been medically cleared to return to the ring. The AEW star has been sidelined since late October following a televised attack that wrote him off television, though the exact nature of his medical issue remains undisclosed. Castagnoli noted that his current time away from the ring allowed him to attend the esports event, where he drew comparisons between the intense passion of gaming fans and professional wrestling crowds.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa renames AEW National Championship 'Ruby'
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa defeated Andrade El Idolo on AEW Collision to become the fifth AEW National Champion in a match filmed aboard the Chris Jericho Cruise. Following his victory, the self-proclaimed belt collector cut a backstage promo highlighting his historic milestones, including winning a title on a cruise ship. Ciampa declared that he intends to collect every championship in AEW on his path to the world title. To mark the occasion, he officially gave the National Championship the nickname Ruby.

stories.title: Booker T reacts to Adam Copeland's upcoming AEW retirement
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently discussed Adam Copeland's announced plan to retire from professional wrestling in 2027 on his Hall of Fame podcast. Booker praised Copeland for staging an inspiring seven-year comeback after initially retiring in 2011 due to neck injuries, successfully capturing championships in both WWE and AEW and reuniting with longtime friend Christian Cage. However, Booker also questioned whether Copeland might regret taking a dangerous high-risk dive off a steel cage against Malakai Black that resulted in a broken leg, noting how veteran wrestlers often struggle with physical limitations. Despite Booker's speculation about the cage dive, Copeland has previously stated in interviews that he does not regret making that high-flying move.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher talks about his AEW singles push
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher recently discussed his unexpected and rapid transition into a singles wrestler within All Elite Wrestling. Speaking on Tony Schiavones podcast ahead of his World title match against Will Ospreay, Fletcher admitted that a singles run was never originally planned when he and Mark Davis signed as Aussie Open. Despite the sudden shift, which included joining the Don Callis Family and capturing championship gold, Fletcher always maintained ultimate confidence in his ability to succeed on his own.

stories.title: Ex-WWE writer claims AEW had backstage cliques during CM Punk controversy
stories.tldr: Former WWE writer Robert Karpeles recently shared his perspective on the AEW backstage environment during the infamous CM Punk Brawl Out incident in 2022. During a podcast appearance, Karpeles explained that the locker room was divided into distinct factions, including groups aligned with Cody Rhodes, Kenny Omega and the Young Bucks, Chris Jericho, and everyone else. He argued that such divisions prevent a roster from working toward a unified goal and contrasted this with Vince McMahon's decisive, single-leader approach in WWE. Ultimately, Karpeles believes that professional wrestling companies require strong, fear-or-inspiration-based leadership where one person makes the final call without hesitation.

stories.title: AEW promoting Survivor 51 contestant and ROH talent Brady Booker
stories.tldr: AEW is actively promoting Ring of Honor developmental talent Brady Booker following his recent stint as a contestant on season 51 of the CBS reality competition Survivor, where he made history as the third professional wrestler to ever compete on the franchise. During a recent episode of AEW Collision, a special video package highlighted Booker's journey in Fiji—where he served as the first member of the jury before being voted off—while also showcasing his in-ring prowess. Booker, formerly known as Bodhi Hayward in WWE NXT, is now turning his full attention back to the squared circle as he looks to make a major impact in AEW and ROH.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez AEW Collision November 7 subscriber report
stories.tldr: Wrestling journalist Bryan Alvarez has released his subscriber-only report covering the November 7 edition of AEW Collision. The exclusive update provides behind the scenes details and analysis of the show for wrestling fans. Subscribers of the publication can now access the full breakdown and commentary regarding the broadcast.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa defeats Andrade El Idolo for AEW National Championship on Collision
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa defeated Andrade El Idolo to capture the AEW National Championship on the November 7, 2026, episode of AEW Collision, which emanated from the Chris Jericho Rock 'N' Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise. The chaotic main event featured heavy interference, a ref bump, low blows, and a slippery ring due to rain, ending Andrade's 104-day title reign. Ciampa successfully capitalized with a roll-up pin after failing to defeat Andrade in their previous encounter at WrestleDream.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné mourns death of younger sister Alexis
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Moné recently revealed in her newsletter that her younger sister, Alexis Varnado, passed away in September, leaving behind two young children. Moné shared deeply personal memories of her sister, including attending WrestleMania together in Atlanta when they were younger and helping care for their mother in 2020. The devastating family loss was further compounded later that month by the unexpected death of her longtime friend and fellow wrestler PAC at the age of 40. Moné continues to navigate her grief while preparing to defend her championship against Marina Shafir at AEW Full Gear on November 14.

stories.title: Kazuchika Okada vs. Adam Copeland International Title match set for AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Kazuchika Okada will defend the AEW International Championship against Adam Copeland at the upcoming AEW Full Gear pay-per-view event. The high-profile match was officially announced following weeks of escalating tension and physical confrontations between the two veteran stars. Their brewing rivalry has been fueled by Okada interfering in Copeland matches and their involvement in chaotic multi-man bouts like Blood and Guts and WrestleDream.

stories.title: Will Ospreay and Kyle Fletcher face-to-face and new matches set for AEW Dynamite & Collision
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a loaded card for an upcoming three-hour live television special combining Dynamite and Collision on November 11, serving as the final stop before the Full Gear pay-per-view. The highlight of the night will be a high-stakes face-to-face confrontation between AEW World Champion Will Ospreay and his challenger Kyle Fletcher. Additionally, fans will witness a major mixed tag team match and a tag team bout building toward next week's championship matches.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher on Don Callis' advice
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently discussed his nearly two-year tenure in the Don Callis Family and shared the best piece of advice he has received from the veteran manager. Speaking on Tony Schiavone podcast, Fletcher noted that Callis frequently sends him clips and weekly suggestions to help refine his work. However, Fletcher emphasized that the most valuable takeaway has been learning to truly believe in his own abilities. That backing and renewed confidence have directly shaped his current in-ring style and overall presentation as he prepares to face Will Ospreay at AEW Full Gear 2026 for the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: Juice Robinson hospitalized after bloody scene on AEW Collision
stories.tldr: Juice Robinson of The Cut was hospitalized following a violent and bloody backstage incident aboard a cruise ship during AEW Collision. Earlier in the night, Jay White and his faction laid out Jon Moxley and The Death Riders, but the situation escalated dramatically when Robinson disappeared, leaving behind a pool of blood and two forks. While suspicion immediately fell on The Death Riders, AEW has not yet confirmed who was responsible for the brutal attack. This developing storyline adds intense heat to the feud between The Cut and The Death Riders as they head toward Full Gear.

stories.title: Jon Moxley and The Death Riders attacked by The Cut and Mercedes Moné on Collision
stories.tldr: During the November 7, 2026 episode of AEW Collision, Jon Moxley and The Death Riders suffered a brutal ambush by Jay White and The Cut following a successful trios match. AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Moné also got involved, exchanging words with Moxley before delivering a kick to his head during the beatdown. The segment culminated with a Blade Runner from White, leaving The Death Riders humiliated and sending a definitive message ahead of Full Gear.

stories.title: WON Flashback: FTR vs. The Young Bucks at AEW Full Gear 2020
stories.tldr: On November 7, 2020, at the AEW Full Gear pay-per-view, The Young Bucks defeated FTR in a critically acclaimed match that received a stellar five and a quarter star rating. The nearly 29-minute encounter for the AEW tag team titles featured intense action, heavy storytelling built around a classic NBA rivalry aesthetic, and numerous homages to legendary tag teams of the past. Ultimately, The Young Bucks secured the victory after overcoming FTR's desperate strategies, leading to post-match celebrations involving Kenny Omega and a poignant moment with Hangman Page.

stories.title: US Senator Ruben Gallego declares allegiance to AEW
stories.tldr: United States Senator Ruben Gallego recently declared his loyalty to All Elite Wrestling on social media. The statement came in response to a fan post joking about his potential future interactions with WWE Hall of Famer Kane on the senate floor. Kane is currently considered a top candidate to be appointed to the U.S. Senate in January 2027 following political shifts in Tennessee. As the wrestling and political worlds potentially collide, Gallego made it clear that he prefers the rival promotion.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite ticket sales update for November 7, 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite is heading to the Maverik Center in West Valley City, Utah, for a special dual taping of Dynamite and Collision serving as the go-home shows for the upcoming Full Gear pay-per-view. According to WrestleTix, 1,580 tickets have been distributed for the event, showing a minor increase of five tickets from the previous day. This figure trails behind the 2,429 tickets distributed the last time the company ran the venue in October 2024. Fans still looking to attend can find standard admission tickets starting at $35.35, with approximately 136 tickets currently available on the resale market.

stories.title: Mick Foley Discusses Darby Allin's High-Risk Wrestling Style
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently revealed that he personally advised AEW star Darby Allin to tone down his dangerous, high-risk wrestling style. Despite Foley sharing his own hard-earned wisdom following Allin's brutal fall off a steel cage during the November 4 edition of AEW Dynamite Blood and Guts, Allin politely declined to change his approach. Meanwhile, former WWE referee Jimmy Korderas criticized the stunt, arguing that Allin has desensitized his audience by repeatedly performing such extreme spots.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Identifies First Star-Making Moment as Edge
stories.tldr: AEW star Adam Copeland recently reflected on his legendary WWE career during a podcast appearance, pinpointing the exact moment he realized he had become a star. He identified the historic first-ever tag team ladder match against The Hardys at No Mercy in Cleveland as his true breakthrough. Copeland also discussed receiving validation from wrestling legend Mick Foley backstage and shared memories of his iconic spear off the ladder at WrestleMania X-Seven.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli Appears at League of Legends World Championship
stories.tldr: AEW star Claudio Castagnoli made a special appearance as a guest announcer at the 2026 League of Legends World Championship quarterfinals in Allen, Texas. He introduced the teams for the match between T1 and Karmine Corp before participating in a brief sideline interview after the first game. Castagnoli revealed to the esports audience that he has been hooked on League of Legends for eight years after originally participating in a show match.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite and WWE NXT Ratings Battle (Nov 4, 2026)
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite and WWE NXT faced off in a major head-to-head ratings battle on November 4, 2026. Dynamite drew massive numbers with its Blood and Guts cage matches, outperforming NXT despite its star-studded lineup featuring John Cena, CM Punk, and Cody Rhodes. AEW secured superior viewership and key demographic ratings, leading to enthusiastic reactions from company leadership.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Viewership Increase (Nov 4, 2026)
stories.tldr: The November 4, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite on TBS experienced a significant viewership surge, drawing 792,000 viewers and a 0.24 rating in the key P18 to 49 demographic. This represents a substantial jump from the previous week's numbers of 620,000 viewers and a 0.21 demo rating. Furthermore, the show saw massive year-over-year growth compared to early November 2025, reflecting a nearly sixty percent increase in total audience. These figures strictly cover linear television broadcast metrics on TBS and exclude any digital or streaming consumption.

stories.title: Chris Jericho to Star in Horror Action Film
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho has been cast as a bounty hunter named The Hunter in a new creature action horror film titled I Am Teeth, directed by Scott B. Hansen and produced by Epic Pictures Group. The story follows middle school children searching for a lost pet who trap a werewolf, only to be pursued by Jericho's character and an even more sinister force. Production is slated for early 2027 following its presentation to buyers at the American Film Market. In addition to this project, Jericho's busy acting schedule includes playing Gorgeous George in an Amazon Prime series, appearing in Dexter: Resurrection, and featuring in Margo's Got Money Troubles, all while continuing his professional wrestling career with AEW.

stories.title: WrestleCon Owner Urges Tony Khan to Run Forbidden Door During WrestleMania Weekend
stories.tldr: WrestleCon owner Michael Bochicchio recently proposed an ambitious idea to AEW President Tony Khan during a live session with Mick Foley. With WWE taking WrestleMania 43 to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in April 2027, Bochicchio suggested that AEW should run a global Forbidden Door weekend in the United States. This strategic move would fill the massive void left for traditional North American wrestling celebrations and conventions during WWE's historic international weekend.

stories.title: Black Tiger Talks Being the 9th to Dawn that Legendary Mask, MLW Saturday Night Superfight, CMLL’s International Appeal, more
stories.tldr: CMLL star Black Tiger recently joined a podcast to discuss his role as the ninth iteration of the legendary wrestling persona. During the conversation, he talked about the immense pressure and hard work required to live up to the legacy established by greats like Eddie Guerrero and Silver King. He also discussed his upcoming appearance at Major League Wrestling Saturday Night Superfight and whether fans will ever see the return of his former persona, Magnus.

stories.title: Mick Foley praises Megan Bayne's performance at AEW Blood & Guts
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley praised Megan Bayne for a career defining performance during the women's Blood and Guts match on AEW Dynamite. Foley shared photos and videos of himself bowing down to the bloodied star, continuing an ongoing running joke with her Divine Dominion stable. While many fans appreciated the veteran showing respect for the extreme punishment Bayne endured, others were left divided and critical of the routine.

stories.title: Brawling Birds postpone indie match following AEW Blood & Guts
stories.tldr: AEW Women's World Tag Team Champions The Brawling Birds have postponed their upcoming independent match for Pro Wrestling EVE following their participation in the violent Blood & Guts match on AEW Dynamite. Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor were scheduled to face Hyperactive in Wolverhampton, but mutually agreed with the promotion to reschedule out of an abundance of caution. The decision allows the duo to rest and prioritize their upcoming tag team title defense against Kris Statlander and Harley Cameron at AEW Full Gear. Reports indicate that despite the brutal nature of the cage match, all participants emerged without major injuries.

stories.title: Athena to defend ROH Women's World Championship against Hyan at Final Battle
stories.tldr: ROH Women’s World Champion Athena has announced her next title defense against Hyan for the upcoming Final Battle event in San Antonio, Texas. During a recent episode of ROH TV, Athena stated that Hyan could bring new life to her Minions in Training group alongside Diamante and Billie Starkz, framing the title match as part of Hyan's initiation. This will mark Hyan's first-ever opportunity to challenge for the ROH Women's Championship during Athena's historic reign, which has now surpassed 1,400 days.

stories.title: AEW restricts commentary terminology during Blood & Guts TV broadcast
stories.tldr: During the recent Dynamite Blood and Guts television broadcast featuring a women's match involving weapons like toy bricks and broken glass, AEW instituted a strict commentary rule prohibiting the use of the brand name LEGO. According to reports from wrestling journalists, commentators were explicitly instructed to use the generic term toy bricks and had to immediately correct themselves if they accidentally uttered the trademarked name. While no direct legal notice was cited, the precaution likely stems from protecting trademark guidelines regarding the well known building block manufacturer.

stories.title: AEW content officially launches on Hulu Japan streaming service
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has officially launched its content on Hulu Japan following an initial partnership announcement made in September. Japanese fans can now stream AEW Dynamite, AEW Collision, and live pay-per-view events exclusively through the platform, which is operated by HJ Holdings and separate from the American Hulu service. The rollout includes catch-up episodes from recent months, with upcoming live pay-per-view events like Full Gear available under specific subscription and purchase terms. This expansion gives AEW a dedicated streaming home in a key international market featuring top stars who already enjoy massive local followings.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher responds to Randy Orton comparisons
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently addressed the ongoing comparisons between himself and WWE veteran Randy Orton. Fletcher admitted that he considers the physical and career comparisons to be a massive compliment given Orton's legendary status. However, he remains focused on carving out his own unique path in professional wrestling. Ultimately, Fletcher hopes to reach a level of success where future generations of wrestlers are compared to him instead.

stories.title: Chris Jericho discusses preparing to play Gorgeous George in Muhammad Ali series
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho recently shared details about his role portraying legendary professional wrestler Gorgeous George in the new Amazon Prime Video limited series The Greatest, which follows the life of Muhammad Ali. Jericho explained that he landed the audition after producers struggled to find the right fit and used an old movie starring George to nail his accent, drawl, and persona. His single-episode appearance highlights a crucial historical meeting between Gorgeous George and a young Cassius Clay in Las Vegas, where the wrestling pioneer taught the future boxing icon how to use showmanship and fan engagement to sell fights.

stories.title: Kevin Knight tops 2026 Black Wrecellence 500 rankings
stories.tldr: Kevin Knight has claimed the number one spot on the 2026 Black Wrecellence 500 rankings, which celebrate 500 Black professional wrestlers worldwide. Unveiled by Righteous Reg, the list highlights industry representation and diversity while taking the crown from previous multi-time leader Mercedes Moné. Moné dropped to second place, with Swerve Strickland, Oba Femi, and Willow Nightingale rounding out the top five.

stories.title: Jake Roberts says Tony Khan needs to loosen up creative reins in AEW
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Jake Roberts recently discussed the creative process in AEW and suggested that CEO Tony Khan needs to loosen his grip on booking. While praising Khan as a kind person with a strong roster, Roberts believes management should be more open to outside advice and better utilize available talent. Roberts also expressed frustration that his former client, Lance Archer, never received the major push he deserved during their time together. This follows Roberts confirming his departure from the company after a relationship that began in 2019.

stories.title: Marina Shafir cuts promo calling Mercedes Moné a 'spoiled little sh*t'
stories.tldr: Following their violent brawl on Dynamite, Marina Shafir fired back at Mercedes Mone in a fiery digital exclusive promo. Shafir blasted the champion's privileged status and corporate backing while defending her own legacy within Jon Moxley's stable. The challenger closed out her address with a stark warning, vowing to reduce the titleholder to tears at Full Gear.

stories.title: Austin Creed cuts backstage promo on Bandido following Blood & Guts
stories.tldr: Following a backstage attack on Kofi by Bandido during Blood and Guts, Austin Creed cut an intense promo declaring that The New Level have lost all respect for Bandido. Creed challenged Bandido to a match next week, setting the stage for a heated escalation alongside Swerve Strickland. The feud will culminate at Full Gear when Creed, Kofi, and Strickland challenge Bandido, Brody King, and Hangman Page for the AEW World Trios titles in a Texas Death Match.
